title: The chart on a report page has no controls of its own
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. On each report below, the chart is shown (click Show chart if it is hidden).
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Sales in the left menu.
  2. Look inside the box that holds the chart, above and around the chart, for any date control, person filter or report link.
  3. Repeat on Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The chart's box holds no date control: the only date control is the report's own one in the toolbar.
  • The chart's box holds no technician or advisor filter: the only one is the report's own one in the toolbar.
  • The chart shows no report link or report icon.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9583 (Story 11, Chart on the Report Page); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 11. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 10 to 13 *_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R4: “The embedded chart has no date-range control of its own.”
  • S11-R5: “The embedded chart has no technician or advisor filter of its own.”
  • S11-R6: “The embedded chart shows no report link.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
